title: Fallout 3 — James Runtime T0-T3 Savegame Differential Protocol v3.1
purpose: Measure what Fallout 3's engine actually persists for the James/MQ04/Vault112 state across four controlled savepoints, while keeping engine save persistence strictly separate from fictional in-world autobiographical-memory persistence.

required_savepoints.T0: Before the Vault 112 / Tranquility Lane session begins.
required_savepoints.T1: Inside Tranquility Lane while James is actively represented as Doc and before the exit sequence.
required_savepoints.T2: As close as practicable to the final pre-exit state, after James/Doc identity is established but before physical return.
required_savepoints.T3: Immediately after physical return to Vault 112, before unrelated MQ05 progress changes the scene further.

capture_requirements: Use the same character/save lineage for T0-T3.
Record exact file SHA-256 and byte size before analysis.
Record game executable/build and active plugin/master order if available.
Prefer manual saves rather than autosaves to reduce unrelated churn.
Avoid inventory changes, travel, combat or unrelated quest progression between adjacent capture anchors where practical.
Keep original .fos files immutable; analyze copies only.

ENGINE_QUEST_STATE: quest script variables such as PlayerInTL, DadInfo, DadDogInfo, DadGreet, NPCReset, SafetyLock, Invasion
ENGINE_REFERENCE_CHANGE_STATE: actor flags or reference-specific change records
SIMULATION_ROLE_STATE: MQ04Doc / MQ04DocRef active representation and any change record associated with it
PHYSICAL_JAMES_STATE: MQDadRef change state before/after TL exit

analysis_stages.meaning: Search immutable save bytes for exact known FormID byte patterns and compare occurrence counts/contexts across T0-T3.
Decode Fallout 3 save/changeform/quest structures with a format-aware parser and bind candidate bytes to structured records.
Classify which structured James/MQ04 states appear, mutate, survive or disappear across T0->T1->T2->T3.
Separate quest/session/reference persistence from any genuinely payload-bearing state.
Only after a payload-bearing runtime object exists may it be tested for an in-world Braun/carrier/export semantic edge.

negative_controls: MQ04PlayerContainerRef is expected to demonstrate ordinary quest/runtime persistence unrelated to James memory.
Unrelated stable base-game FormIDs should be sampled to estimate accidental raw-byte hit stability.
File-size and global byte churn between saves must be reported so a single local hit is not overinterpreted.

next_gate.name: FALLOUT3_FOS_STRUCTURED_CHANGEFORM_AND_QUEST_STATE_DECODER_v3.2
next_gate.activation: After at least T1/T2/T3 .fos files are supplied, ideally full T0-T3.
next_gate.goal: Turn R0 byte candidates into structured save-record evidence and compute the first true persistence break across the Tranquility Lane exit.
